properties.name: Downtown & Uptown
properties.info: The central business district, the Arts District and Deep Ellum, with Uptown, Oak Lawn and the Design District north and west of it.

properties.name: East Dallas
properties.info: Old East Dallas, Lakewood, Lower Greenville and the neighbourhoods around White Rock Lake.

properties.name: Lake Highlands
properties.info: North of White Rock Lake, between Northwest Highway and LBJ (I-635), with Vickery Meadow to its west.

properties.name: North Dallas
properties.info: Preston Hollow and the neighbourhoods along the Dallas North Tollway and Central Expressway, up to LBJ (I-635).

properties.name: Far North Dallas
properties.info: North of LBJ (I-635), up to the Collin and Denton county lines: Prestonwood and the neighbourhoods around Bent Tree.

properties.name: Northwest Dallas
properties.info: Love Field, Bachman Lake, the Medical District and Harry Hines, out to Cypress Waters by DFW Airport.

properties.name: West Dallas
properties.info: Across the Trinity from downtown, by the Margaret Hunt Hill Bridge: Trinity Groves and the West Dallas neighbourhoods.

properties.name: Oak Cliff
properties.info: South and west of the Trinity: Bishop Arts, Kessler Park, Winnetka Heights and the neighbourhoods out to Mountain Creek Lake.

properties.name: South Dallas
properties.info: Fair Park and the historic neighbourhoods south-east of downtown, along MLK Jr. Boulevard.

properties.name: Southern Dallas
properties.info: South of Oak Cliff along I-35E and US 67, out to Red Bird and the city’s southern edge.

properties.name: Pleasant Grove
properties.info: South-east Dallas, east of the Trinity and south of I-30, out to the city’s eastern edge.
